title: Feature request: Using carelink.minimed.com or carelink.minimed.eu as a BS source, with treatments and carbs
symptom: The user switched to Medtronic Enlite sensors and could not set xDrip to show values from this sensor directly. They managed to set up a Nightscout that takes data from carelink.minimed.com or carelink.minimed.eu and use it as a source in xDrip+ Nightscout follower, but they find this complicated and request a less complicated way to connect directly to the Medtronic CGM or to take BS, carbs, and treatments from the Carelink Minimed portal.
evidence_quote: There should be a less complicated way to do this, ideal were to connect directly to the Medtronic CGM as hardware source, but the other method should also be good enough, to take the BS,carbs&treatments from the Carelink Minimed portal, as the Nightscout does.
